name: Obsidian Blade
description: A razor-sharp blade forged from deep volcanic obsidian glass. Exceptionally lethal with high scaling.

name: Frostfang Dagger
description: Carved from glacial permafrost, this dagger chills enemies on hit, slowing their movement and attacks.

name: Sunfire Longsword
description: Imbued with radiant solar heat, each strike engulfs foes in intense flickering flame.

name: Soul Reaver
description: An ominous dark war scythe that harvests life essence from dungeon creatures, restoring the wielder's vitality.

name: Stormbreaker Hammer
description: A thunderous great hammer infused with crackling lightning that shocks targets with tremendous kinetic force.

name: Shadow Dagger
description: A featherlight stealth blade favored by dungeon assassins. Quick, silent, and deadly.
